final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: sink 10uA reference
M0  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=6  L=1
* tail current source 20uA
M5  tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=12 L=1
* input pair (vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> vinp non-inverting)
M1  n1    vinn  tail vss nfet W=6  L=0.5
M2  n2    vinp  tail vss nfet W=6  L=0.5
* PMOS mirror load
M3  n1    n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=8  L=1
M4  n2    n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=8  L=1
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink (100uA)
M7  vout  n2    vdd  vdd pfet W=80 L=1
M8  vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=60 L=1
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  n2    nc    2k
Cc  nc    vout  1p
.ends
